description: List the community entries (user-published content, neblla.community) of an app from the backoffice, any status. Use it to triage the moderation queue: status "pending" is what awaits approval in review mode. Returns indexed metadata only (title, summary, category, tags, contentType, owner, status, moderation record); fetch a payload with neblla_get_community_entry. Paginate with `cursor` = the previous `next`.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call

ownerId.description: Filter by the author id shown as entry.owner.id

q.description: Text search over title / summary / tags

name: neblla_list_community_entries
